title: Being someone else?
content: I had one of the weirdest experiences in my dream world last night. I was in college (currently in college but this was not my college, it was the dreamworld college I’ve been to before returning to real world college, this is also NOT the dream university) and heading to class. I was “running late” and when I approached the door to the classroom I could already see it was a portal. There were other students seated at desks listening to the professor who was seated casually at the front of the class, she was defining roles in a performance for each student. The background of the room was black/purple/swirly like a portal/void. I realized I was dreaming at this point. Some of the students were instructed to head to the auditorium (the stage) to begin practicing the performance. The students left in the classroom were talking to each other and the professor was organizing her papers. I went up to her and apologized for being late and asked her what my role was for the performance, she looked over the sheet and showed me my name and role. This is where it got weird, I reached down to point at it and saw my hand was not my own. I am a white woman and my hand was that of a black womans. The name she called me was incorrect. I tried to correct her and she told me she didn’t have a (my name) in the class and that she knew my name was ____. I don’t remember the name. I left the classroom and went to the bathroom to look in the mirror. It wasn’t me in the mirror. I was fully aware that I was dreaming and began to look at myself in the mirror. I had 20 braids (I counted) and tried to connect that I was (my name) and ____ in this dream. I smiled at myself in the mirror and saw that my teeth were extremely tiny (they looked like veneers before veneers) and as I touched them they began to fall out. I pulled a couple out in the front and inspected further where I could see there were larger teeth growing in. From the moment I entered the classroom until the teeth experience, it didn’t feel like MY mallworld. I felt like both myself and a totally different person. In the mirror, it felt like I was sharing an experience with the woman whose face I was wearing. I knew I was ME but it also like I was experiencing someone else’s dream? This woman was a theatre major, I am not. It was like I could feel *her* and I was trying to not mess things up in her dreams. It was just a really eerie experience, I can’t place her face and I can’t remember her name! I read it on the professors sheet of paper but then it got all warped when I tried to explain to her that I wasn’t this person. I’ve had dreams where I’m other characters but nothing like this before where I examined myself so clearly, aware I was “in another body” It felt as though when I stepped into the portal/classroom, I took over someone else’s dream. Idk it was just weird!
